title: Information a pharmacy must maintain where eligible medications are administered
rule_summary: Circular Letter DCP 26-03-124 provides that a pharmacy where any of the eligible medications are administered must maintain the following information: patient consent; patient screening information, including at least date of birth and other relevant vital statistics, known allergies, and other medications taken; type of medication administered; manufacturer; lot number; expiration date; date of administration; route and site of administration; pharmacist or pharmacy intern (signature or initials and title); adverse outcome, if any; and adverse event, if any.
exam_relevance: Tests that the record-keeping duty rests on the pharmacy where the eligible medications are administered, and what information the record must contain.

authority.name: Circular Letter DCP 26-03-124, Pharmacist Administration of Medications, March 11, 2026

common_confusions: Placing the record-keeping duty on the individual pharmacist alone, when the circular places it on the pharmacy where any of the eligible medications are administered.
Assuming the circular states a retention period for these records; its Record Keeping section does not state one.
verification_notes: Read on 2026-09-14 in Circular Letter DCP 26-03-124, Pharmacist Administration of Medications, dated March 11, 2026, in the Word document linked from the Department's news page on mass.gov.
